class.name: SteamParties
class.brief_description: Steam Party discovery, reservations and exact Game-owned publication.

method.name: locations
method.description: Reads up to 128 eligible Steam Chat locations as typed snapshots. Empty eligible lists are valid.

method.name: beacons
method.description: Reads visible beacons with compatible bounded Game lobby metadata. Snapshots remain readable after the SDK changes its visible list.

method.name: publish
method.description: Await a [SteamPartyBeaconResult]. The listing must be this Game scope's live owned non-private Steam lobby. Choose a currently eligible location and one to 64 unreserved seats within authority capacity. A process can publish one beacon at a time.

method.name: reserve
method.description: Await a [SteamListingResult]. Steam reserves a seat and returns an owner-bound locator for [method GameRuntime.join_listing]. Game admission still verifies the live lobby owner and rules. An abandoned reservation expires on the host.

signal.name: beacons_changed
signal.description: Emitted when Steam says the visible beacons or eligible locations changed. Read a fresh snapshot when handling it.
